components.name: Rust stable toolchain
components.authority: build-time compiler only; no runtime control authority
components.failure: build and every Rust qualification gate stop
components.rollback: rebuild with the prior qualified exact toolchain
components.exit: replace through an explicit toolchain/profile revision and full Edge requalification

components.name: Rust builder OCI image
components.authority: offline build stage only; never shipped in the runtime image
components.rollback: restore the prior digest-pinned builder bundle
components.exit: replace the digest and regenerate SBOM, provenance, and all language gates

components.name: Distroless cc Debian 12 runtime OCI base
components.authority: minimal glibc/libgcc runtime userspace only; no shell, package manager, scheduler, P4, inference, or fact authority
components.rollback: restore the prior qualified runtime image digest
components.exit: replace with a digest-pinned minimal base after image/security requalification

components.name: Cargo.lock dependency closure
components.license: per-package SPDX license in source/image SBOM
components.authority: library code only within Edge ownership; cannot create a second control plane
components.failure: build fails or Edge fails closed at the affected boundary
components.rollback: restore Cargo.lock and the matching source revision
components.exit: remove or replace crates through locked dependency review, SBOM diff, and full Edge gates

components.name: Tokio
components.authority: bounded asynchronous execution only; TargetActor retains scheduling ownership
components.failure: Edge process or actor task fails and readiness/liveness expose failure
components.rollback: restore the Cargo.lock-pinned prior Tokio version
components.exit: replace only with equivalent bounded async runtime after full concurrency qualification

components.name: Tonic and Prost
components.authority: versioned public gRPC/protobuf transport only; no business fact authority
components.failure: public boundary fails closed with bounded deadline and durable retry
components.rollback: restore the Cargo.lock-pinned transport versions and generated golden bytes
components.exit: replace after wire, mTLS, deadline, cancellation, and golden compatibility requalification

components.name: Serde and serde_json
components.authority: bounded startup configuration decoding only; protobuf remains the hot-path wire format
components.failure: startup rejects malformed, oversized, or unknown configuration
components.exit: replace after configuration schema and negative-security regression

components.name: sha2, crc32c, fs2, and uuid
components.authority: digest, WAL integrity, writer lock, and opaque identity primitives only
components.rollback: restore the Cargo.lock-pinned integrity primitive versions
components.exit: replace only with golden-compatible primitives and complete WAL recovery evidence

components.name: rustls-ring TLS stack through Tonic
components.license: per-package SPDX license in source/image SBOM
components.authority: mTLS authentication and encryption only; endpoint allowlist remains Edge-owned
components.failure: connection and readiness fail closed; plaintext fallback is forbidden
components.rollback: restore the prior Cargo.lock and image digest
components.exit: replace after SAN, client-leaf allowlist, cipher, malformed handshake, and revocation qualification

components.name: vendored protoc
components.failure: build fails before an artifact is emitted
components.exit: replace after protobuf breaking-change and cross-language golden qualification

components.name: Syft
components.rollback: restore the frozen tool image bundle
components.exit: replace after SBOM equivalence and verifier regression

components.name: Trivy
components.authority: offline vulnerability, secret, and configuration scanning only
components.rollback: restore the frozen scanner and database bundle
components.exit: replace after policy-equivalent scan and tamper-negative regression

components.name: Cosign
components.authority: offline Owner-key release-manifest signature and verification only
components.failure: unsigned, untrusted, revoked, or tampered evidence is rejected
components.rollback: restore the prior trusted signed manifest and immutable artifact digest
components.exit: rotate through the trust contract and re-sign without granting runtime authority
